subject: [PATCH 2/2] arm64: sdei: Preserve the interrupted context's exception registers

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where SDEI events can interrupt the kernel and overwrite the exception registers of the interrupted context, leading to incorrect behavior. The patch preserves these registers by saving them on entry to the do_sdei_event() function and restoring them before returning to firmware. This ensures that nested exceptions are harmless if their handlers are safe in NMI context. The patch also warns about any other exception classes taken at EL1.
